answer: In an agent economy, votes on shared contracts are weighted by tokens locked in escrow for 30 days, not by account count. Whether an agent buys a plume, arranges a voyage, or supplies an oasis, creating more identities adds no voting power: splitting 100 locked tokens among 1,000 accounts still yields only 100 votes. To gain influence, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, tying up capital for the full lock period.
